title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Speaking Test 1 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: How much walking do you do in your daily life?
Did you walk more when you were at school than now?
What places are there to go for a walk near where you live?
Would you ever like to go on a walking holiday?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a play or a film you have seen that you would like to see again with friends.
cue_card_bullets: what play or film you'd like to go to see again
what other people have said about this play or film
and explain why you would like to see this play or film again with friends

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What are the most popular kinds of plays or shows at theatres in your country?
How easy is it to get tickets to the theatre?
Do you think theatres need to do more to attract younger audiences?
What do you think attracts people to working as an actor?
What are some of the qualities that a person needs to have if they want to become an actor?
Can you think of any disadvantages of working as an actor?
